content: The next page of the Prologue corrects the order ('Or rather, Planet-Pearl-Peach'): the book first flies up to the realm Mental (Planet), the metaphysical ceiling of being; then dives down to the realm Written (Pearl), to find the same Light in the blackness of Ink, physicality; then enters the Paradise of the realm Spoken (Peach); and the fourth and final part discourses at greater length on the Letter itself.
